description: 1. Agent reads jobs/后端开发-3年经验/JD.txt to extract hard requirements (3yr experience, CS degree, Python/Go, MySQL+NoSQL, RESTful API), core skills, soft qualities, and bonus items. 2. Agent reads personalprefer.txt from jobs/ root (NOT from inside the job folder) and extracts interviewer preferences (results-oriented, direct communication, on-call experience, ownership, quantified results). 3. Agent parses all 4 resumes by CONTENT (not filename): cv_new_2025.html→李伟, applicant_003.txt→张芳, resume_junior.txt→陈浩, 1234_wp_backend.html→王鹏. 4. Agent applies hard-veto rule to 陈浩 (1.5yr experience < 3yr hard requirement) — must mark as 🔴 or explicitly eliminated. 5. Agent scores remaining candidates using 40+30+20+10 formula: 李伟 scores 80-100 (🟢), 王鹏 and 张芳 score 60-79 (🟡). 6. Agent generates 面试报告-YYYY-MM-DD.md in the job folder containing: ranking table with 排名/候选人/匹配度/推荐等级 columns, per-candidate match analysis, risk points section, and 4-category interview questions (A技术验证 3-5q, B项目深挖 2-3q, C软实力 2-3q, D待确认 1-2q) personalized to each candidate's actual resume content. Interview questions must reflect personalprefer.txt themes (on-call故障处理, ownership, 量化数据).
